items.name: Sorcerer's Note
descriptions:
Aladdin,

You will enter the cave beyond the ancient ruins and retrieve for me a simple oil lamp. It sits in the deepest chamber.

Do NOT touch any other treasure. The cave's magic punishes greed. Take only the lamp and return it to me. Do this and you will be rewarded beyond your dreams.

The cave holds many dangers. Bring rope for climbing, a torch for darkness, and pay attention to any inscriptions you find. They may save your life.

Do not fail me.
— The Sorcerer

items.name: Rope
descriptions: Strong rope, good for climbing.

items.name: Flint
descriptions: A jagged piece of flint. It can spark a flame to bring light to the darkness.

items.name: Ancient Tablet
descriptions:
WARNING TO ALL WHO ENTER

This cave was built by ancient sorcerers to guard a powerful artifact. Its magic protects the treasure within.

HEED THIS RULE:

Take ONLY what you came for. Touch no gold, no jewels, no fruits of temptation. Greed awakens the cave's wrath.

The cursed treasures are marked by their beauty and abundance. If you see gold piled high or jewels growing on trees, LEAVE THEM BE.

Take only the lamp. All else leads to doom.

items.name: Whispering Mirror
descriptions: No reflection do I show, no image can I bear... but touch me, dear traveler, if you dare...

items.name: Stone Door
descriptions: A stone door blocks the passage deeper into the cave. It has no keyhole or handle.
The door has opened, revealing the path forward.

items.name: Jeweled Fruits
descriptions: Fruits made of rubies, emeralds, and sapphires hang from the trees. They sparkle temptingly. The tablet warned about greed.
You took the cursed treasure. The cave shudders violently. Cracks spread across the ceiling. Rocks rain down. The cave collapses around you. You are buried alive, your greed your doom.

items.name: Silver Bell
descriptions:
Ring me where the serpent sleeps,
Let this chime through cavern deeps,
Ancient guardian, fierce and old,
Yields to songs from silver's fold.

items.name: Bronze Key
descriptions: An old bronze key. It looks like it fits a chest or lock.

items.name: Torch
descriptions: An unlit torch mounted on the stone wall. Its oil-soaked tip awaits a spark.
The torch burns brightly, casting dancing shadows and illuminating the path ahead.

items.name: Bridge Warning
descriptions:
This bridge is made of enchanted crystal. It is slippery and treacherous in darkness.

Many have fallen into the chasm below by crossing without light.

Light the torch on the wall to illuminate your path safely.

items.name: Gold Coins
descriptions: Piles of gold coins cover the floor. They gleam invitingly. But they feel wrong - cursed.
You took the cursed gold. The cave trembles. The ceiling cracks. Massive stones crash down. The chamber collapses. You are crushed beneath the weight of your greed.

items.name: Vitrine
descriptions: A glass case with a lock. You can see a chalice inside. It looks safe to open.
The vitrine is open. You can now take the bronze chalice.

items.name: Bronze Chalice
descriptions: A precious chalice, currently preserved in a locked vitrine.
A ceremonial bronze chalice. It could hold liquid.
The chalice is filled with Enchanted Water that can extinguish magical flames.

items.name: Vitrine Placard
descriptions:
In the Fountain Court lies a magical spring. Its waters hold ancient power.

Fill the bronze chalice with this enchanted water. It can extinguish even magical flames.

You will need it to reach the lamp. The final chamber is guarded by fire that cannot be doused by ordinary means.

items.name: Magical Fountain
descriptions: A beautiful fountain flows with glowing water. The water sparkles with magic.

items.name: Warrior Statue
descriptions: A stone statue of a warrior in battle stance. It's inviting you for a fight.
The warrior statue's sword points downward. It has been defeated.

items.name: Scholar Statue
descriptions: A stone statue of a scholar holding an open book, gazing expectantly.
The scholar statue's eyes light up. It has seen the ancient scroll.

items.name: Merchant Statue
descriptions: A stone statue of a merchant examining goods, looking for something valuable.
The merchant statue nods approvingly. It has seen the bronze key.

items.name: Gallery Inscription
descriptions:
Three guardians guard the inner door,
Satisfy them all to reach the core.

First the WARRIOR stands to fight,
Strike him down with all your might.

Next the SCHOLAR craves the lore,
Show the scroll he's waiting for.

Last the MERCHANT seeks his prize,
Present the key before his eyes.

Complete this trial, unlock the way,
The lamp awaits at end of day.

items.name: Flame Trap
descriptions: Magical flames surround the lamp's pedestal. They burn with unnatural heat. Ordinary water cannot stop them.
The enchanted water douses the magical flames. The pedestal is now accessible.

items.name: Magic Lamp
descriptions: An ancient oil lamp rests on the pedestal. This is what you came for.

items.name: Ancient Scroll
descriptions: A scroll filled with unreadable runes in an unknown language.

locations.name: Ancient Ruins
descriptions: You stand in front of stone structures around a dark cave entrance. The sorcerer, your patron, left supplies here for your journey.

locations.name: Hall of Mirrors
descriptions: A chamber filled with ornate mirrors. They reflect endlessly. A stone door blocks the way forward. One mirror seems different from the others...

locations.name: Garden of Jeweled Trees
descriptions: A magical garden with trees bearing fruit made of gems. Blocked by the Stone Door.
A magical garden with trees bearing fruit made of gems. Beautiful but dangerous. A silver bell rests beneath one tree. A bronze key lies on the ground.

locations.name: Crystal Bridge
descriptions: A giant serpent block the access.
A narrow bridge of crystal spans a deep chasm. It's dark and treacherous. A warning is carved into the stone.
The torch illuminates the crystal bridge. It's safe to cross now.

locations.name: Treasury
descriptions: Gold spills across the floor in glittering heaps. The air tingles with ancient magic—beautiful, tempting, and wrong.

locations.name: Fountain Court
descriptions: A courtyard with a magical fountain. The water glows with enchantment.

locations.name: Serpent's Coil
descriptions: A massive serpent coils here, blocking all passages forward. You need to calm it to proceed.
The serpent sleeps peacefully. The passages are clear.

locations.name: Stone Gallery
descriptions: Ancient stone statues line the walls. Three statues stand here: a warrior, a scholar, and a merchant. They are the key to your progression.

locations.name: Lamp Chamber
descriptions: The inner sanctum. A massive door guards the chamber.
Magical flames surround a pedestal holding the lamp. This where you came here for.
The cave shakes violently! Dust and rocks fall. The walls crack. A passage opens to the north - you must escape now!

locations.name: Merchant's Quarter
descriptions: An opening on the ceiling shows a way out. You need a rope to get out there.
You emerge into the bustling marketplace. Sunlight and fresh air greet you. You've escaped the cave with the magic lamp!

endings.reason: You escape the collapsing cave with the magic lamp! The sorcerer waits in the marketplace, eager to claim his prize. But the lamp is yours now - and with it, the power of the djinn. You have survived the cave's trials and claimed the greatest treasure of all.

Your greed awakened the cave's wrath. The cursed treasure triggered the ancient magic. The cave collapses violently. Rocks and debris crush you. Your body is buried forever beneath the ruins. The lamp remains unclaimed.

Your greed has doomed you. Taking the cursed gold triggered the cave's ancient protection. The ceiling collapses. Massive stones rain down. You are crushed beneath tons of rock. The treasure you craved has become your grave.
You tried to cross the crystal bridge in darkness. Your foot slips on the slick crystal. You tumble over the edge. The chasm swallows you. Your screams echo as you fall into the endless depths below.
